Telecom and Energy: Requests by Stage
definition.sql: SELECT kind, status, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM tel_connection_request WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) GROUP BY kind, status ORDER BY kind, status

target.query: Telecom and Energy: Requests by Stage

definition.name: Telecom and Energy: Open Outages
definition.sql: SELECT id, title, area_codes, started_at, customers_affected FROM tel_outage WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND status = 'open' ORDER BY started_at

definition.name: Telecom and Energy: Complaints Near Regulator Deadline
definition.sql: SELECT id, reference, regulator, regulator_deadline FROM tel_complaint WHERE (is_active IS NULL OR is_active = true) AND outcome = 'open' AND regulator_deadline < NOW() + INTERVAL '5 days' ORDER BY regulator_deadline

target.query: Telecom and Energy: Complaints Near Regulator Deadline
